goal: Integrate and verify: Local bounded-control integration capstone

allowed_scope.extent: End a coordinator episode during duplicate/delayed outcomes; a fresh context reconstructs identical authorized actions, attention survives, completed judgment suppresses recovery, and stale epoch cannot send. Use proven store/consumer/readback plus fake time; stopped scans surface DEGRADED/STALE health. Local proof cannot discharge supervised-host, live transport, cutover or retirement gates.
allowed_scope.boundary: Only this node extent. Requirement/design references constrain execution and do not absorb sibling scopes.
non_goals: Replanning the DAG or implementing another node; changing requirements, closing authority gaps or selecting withdrawn architecture policy.
Automatic release, live operation or retirement from a candidate or local proof result.
Inventing or repairing upstream capabilities inside this capstone; return defects to their named provider.
architecture_constraints: Apply the pinned shared contracts and linked contract sections within this node extent. No service or context boundary beyond the pinned design, RAI wiring or adopted withdrawn edge table.
Preserve compatible interfaces, persisted resource identities, one-writer ownership and existing approved architecture checks.

dependencies.completion_predicate: Boundary tests: one BIU, age 3600s, 32 transitions, blocked 300s, one accepted contradiction, state-vector/authority/provider/model change. UNBOUND usage is explicit with numeric check disabled; BOUND uses same-invocation/current-check valid observation and >=0.8 ends, missing/stale/invalid ends conservatively. Invalid contradiction judgment cannot end as authoritative input. Two competing epochs cannot overwrite; no automatic renewal/budget reset.

Persist instance/generation, tick and scan outcomes independently of model life/workload. At 2*I remains in bound, above becomes STALE; failed/incomplete scan DEGRADED, absent/unreadable/regressing clock UNVERIFIED. End episode without losing local monitor state; this is a service/inspection fixture, not deployment supervision.

With binding SF-REQ-056 authority: fake-clock G=300/I=60/C=90 boundaries, active/pending/completed/unknown/terminal/no-closure cases, and unavailable-evidence holds. Delayed original plus two contenders and crash/restart retain one authorized effect/readback. Completed judgment suppresses indefinitely; valid resolution permits reinspection only. Guard- and suppression-removal controls fail. No status toggles/new retries. Local proof does not claim operational monitor-host replacement.

required_evidence: Retain exact fixture/source/profile/candidate revisions, invocation and command, expected/observed result, exit status, immutable observation refs, independent verdict where required; never infer operational success from a local result.

Retain predecessor candidate identities, proof fixture revision, full command/exit status, raw observations, negative-control application counts and independent verdicts separately. Preserve prior proof on repair; supersession needs explicit authority.
Retain all authority dispositions and migration/rollback/readback receipts applicable to this node. Missing or unavailable measurements are explicit holds, never zero or PASS.

criteria: End a coordinator episode during duplicate/delayed outcomes; a fresh context reconstructs identical authorized actions, attention survives, completed judgment suppresses recovery, and stale epoch cannot send. Use proven store/consumer/readback plus fake time; stopped scans surface DEGRADED/STALE health. Local proof cannot discharge supervised-host, live transport, cutover or retirement gates.
material_failure_classes: Episode termination/restart reconstructs the same authorized bounded-control state and stale epoch actions cannot send.
Durable attention survives restart and completed judgment suppresses liveness recovery until valid resolution or supersession.
Stopped/stale/degraded monitor evidence remains explicit and cannot become a healthy operational claim.
Duplicate/delayed outcomes preserve one authorized effect/readback identity across the local composed path.
non_claims: No supervised-host deployment or bootstrap replacement is claimed.
No live G+I, cutover, sovereignty or retirement claim is made.

candidate_custody.policy: Future PRODUCER pins contract/input/baseline/profile and candidate branch+full SHA; publishes candidate to configured authorized remote and records exact branch/SHA on the Issue before RESULT=VERIFY. Fresh independent verifier retrieves that exact SHA in its own worktree; retain retrieval and verdict receipts.
candidate_custody.closure: Retain actor-owned branch/worktree through required closure; disposition LANDED, DISCARDED or PARKED with durable blocker. No direct main push by a BIU worker.
candidate_custody.current_artifact: Candidate specification only; no Issue, branch publication, implementation commit or worker invocation created by Phase 12.

landing: SWF-19: merge exact accepted candidate SHA; no pull request.
stop_condition: Hold this BIU on unmet dependency proof, unbound budget/custody, authority gap/gate, source revision mismatch, unavailable evidence, failing discriminating probe or conflicting ownership. Preserve unrelated completed proof.
escalation_condition: Return defects in C3/C4/L1 predecessor behavior to the owning BIU; preserve completed proof.
Hold rather than infer operational supervision or retirement from this local capstone.
readiness: Remain TASKS until all predecessors are DONE and fresh native Agent Ready returns READY; no release authority.
